purpose: Fail-closed inventory of phone-sync friction seams observed in live operator pairing. Agents must not leave these as chat lore.

designSources.mechanism: State-machine / step views for completed vs next action

seams.symptom: Operator must hunt hash-named .ehsync or 32/64-char chat titles
seams.requiredBehavior: Host stages only fixed names: pairing-offer.json, PAIRING_CODE.txt, escapehatch-answers.ehsync, EscapeHatchAssist-debug.apk
seams.forbiddenAgentResponse: Tell the operator to search Drive or chat for a hash/title

seams.symptom: Pair screen leads with Choose EscapeHatchPhoneDrop folder; Drive opens; operator does not know which folder
seams.requiredBehavior: When LAN base URL is present, primary CTA is Fetch sealed offer from PC. Folder grant is Offline backup only and must name EscapeHatchPhoneDrop exactly in copy
seams.forbiddenAgentResponse: Send the operator into Google Drive without a fixed folder name and LAN-first alternative

seams.symptom: Desktop or phone Chrome shows Continue to site for http://LAN:18765
seams.requiredBehavior: Host never Start-Process a LAN IP URL. Operator desktop preview uses http://127.0.0.1 only via private-sync-focus-operator-browser.ps1. Phone install copy prefers DuckDuckGo/Firefox or Continue-once; Assist LAN fetch uses cleartext OkHttp
seams.forbiddenAgentResponse: Open http://192.168.x.x:18765 in the default desktop browser

seams.symptom: Agent opens QR/helper/corridor across every browser on the host
seams.requiredBehavior: Attach existing EscapeHatch-titled browser via title/PID focus helper; never spray Start-Process browser launches for phone session
seams.forbiddenAgentResponse: Start-Process chrome/brave/edge/qr/png without attaching the EscapeHatch tab first

seams.symptom: Agent says corridor shows the 16-character code while UI only shows Vault sealed + Pair this phone
seams.requiredBehavior: When vault is SYNCED, corridor must auto-open the pairing sheet and display a live pairing code (POST /pair) without requiring the operator to invent a second click. Desktop also writes ESCAPE_HATCH_PAIRING_CODE.txt on stage
seams.forbiddenAgentResponse: Claim the code is visible on corridor without the pair sheet open and a 16-character code rendered

seams.symptom: pairing-code.local.txt opens empty in an editor; operator cannot find the code
seams.requiredBehavior: Stage script writes non-empty PAIRING_CODE.txt into EscapeHatchPhoneDrop and Desktop ESCAPE_HATCH_PAIRING_CODE.txt; open with notepad.exe that path after stage when -OpenCodeNotepad
seams.forbiddenAgentResponse: Point at TEMP pairing-code.local.txt without verifying non-empty content

seams.symptom: Buttons do not change when offer is loaded or code is entered; operator cannot see what is complete
seams.requiredBehavior: Pairing UI is a step machine: Offer pending|loaded, Code pending|ready, Confirm enabled only when both ready; completed steps show done labeling
seams.forbiddenAgentResponse: Leave Confirm enabled/disabled without reflecting offer+code readiness

seams.symptom: Operator must ask the agent for every next tap
seams.requiredBehavior: Status line always names the single next operator action. Host corridor fine-print matches Android status. Agents execute host actions; they do not substitute chat for missing UI state
seams.forbiddenAgentResponse: Replace missing product next-action labeling with repeated chat scavenger hunts

seams.symptom: Agent uses Playwright/Computer Use as the product path instead of EscapeHatch host logic
seams.requiredBehavior: LAN server, stage pack, focus helper, Nord window, and Assist LAN fetch are the product path. Browser automation is recovery only, never the designed operator flow
seams.forbiddenAgentResponse: Treat Playwright clicking Continue to site as the durable fix for HTTPS-First

seams.symptom: Phone cannot reach :18765 while Nord is up; Nord left down after transfer
seams.requiredBehavior: Short Nord disconnect window with hard RestoreOnly/finally; prefer Drive/OneDrive when Nord must stay up; never leave Nord down after proof or timeout

seams.symptom: Copy says folder auto-fills code while LAN path leaves code empty (code never served on LAN)
seams.requiredBehavior: LAN path copy must say: Fetch offer from PC, then type the desktop corridor/Desktop code. Only folder path claims auto-fill from PAIRING_CODE.txt
seams.forbiddenAgentResponse: Promise LAN auto-fills the pairing code
